component.name: AlterSend
component.summary: Send files straight between your devices, end-to-end encrypted

description.p: This is a community package of AlterSend, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.
AlterSend sends files directly from one device to another. Nothing is uploaded to a server and nothing is stored anywhere in between — the transfer is peer to peer and end-to-end encrypted.

ul.li: No account, no signup, no email address
No size limit: a photo and a 500 GB archive take the same path
Share a code, a link or a QR code with the recipient
Recipients without the app can receive in a browser
Pair a device once, then send to it without a code
Works on a local network or across continents
Also available for macOS, Windows, Android and iOS

description.p: Received files go to your Downloads folder, which is the only place this package can write by default. Two permissions are deliberately withheld and can be granted if you want them:

ul.li: Webcam, to scan a peer's QR code instead of pasting the code: flatpak override --user --device=all com.altersend.AlterSend
Somewhere other than Downloads to save into, without confirming the folder through the file-chooser portal each time: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home com.altersend.AlterSend

description.p: Picking files to send always goes through the file-chooser portal, so it works for any file you select without granting anything.
